task_title: BT-86: third-party module currency audit and scheduled-pass follow-up
task_criteria: (1) go list -mod=mod -m -u all re-run at the tick HEAD is quoted and every module that still shows an available upgrade is either upgraded or explicitly justified per module in the row note. (2) Any upgrade lands in ONE commit via targeted go get per module plus go mod tidy and go.sum update, with no new indirect dependency the code does not need (go.mod diff quoted). (3) Full verification on the resulting tree: go build ./... and go vet ./..., go test ./... -count=1 (full, not -short), go test -race ./... -count=1 -short, govulncheck ./... reporting no vulnerabilities, and make fmt-check version-check spec-check vuln-check cover-check all pass. (4) A failure caused by an upgrade is fixed at the call sites, not dodged by pinning back without a stated reason. (5) If a scheduled dependency-currency pass is the right shape, a follow-up board row is filed rather than adding CI configuration silently.
